 CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose \- to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award\-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.
 



  





**About CIBC India:** 




 CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):** 




 The Manager, Central Reconciliations provides strategic and operational leadership for a critical function supporting the integrity, control, and scalability of reconciliation activities across the enterprise. The role leads the continued evolution of the Central Reconciliations team in CIBC India, ensuring operational readiness to support business growth, regulatory expectations, and modernization priorities. This position oversees automated and manual reconciliations, regulatory reporting, and suspense account management while driving standardization, control enhancement, process optimization, and service excellence. The role also acts as a subject matter expert for reconciliation operations and the TLM application.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):** 




**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:** 



* Lead the day\-to\-day operations and ongoing evolution of the Central Reconciliations function, including automated and manual reconciliations, regulatory reporting, and suspense account oversight.
* Establish and maintain a scalable operating model aligned to business growth and enterprise priorities, while delivering against service levels, operational metrics, productivity targets, and control standards.
* Identify and implement opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, and improve operational efficiency through modernization, standardization, and process enhancement initiatives.
* Support the migration of critical and time\-sensitive activities into the Central Reconciliations model with minimal disruption, partnering with Technology and Change teams to enhance tooling, exception management, reporting, and data feeds.
* Maintain a strong control environment by proactively identifying, escalating, and mitigating operational risks, and partnering with Audit, Compliance, Risk, and Regulatory stakeholders to support reviews, remediation, and sustained compliance.
* Build strong partnerships across Capital Markets, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and other business stakeholders to support service delivery and business priorities.
* Lead, coach, and develop a high\-performing team while managing capacity planning, resource allocation, succession planning, budget management, staffing strategy, and investment priorities aligned to the function’s roadmap.
* Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with Capital Markets, Retail, Wealth Management, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and other Operations teams across CIBC
* Partners with business stakeholders, control functions, and technology teams to resolve operational issues, support service delivery, and implement process improvements
* Liaises with internal and external stakeholders, as applicable, to address exceptions, support reconciliation activities, and meet business, audit, and regulatory requirements


- 


**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* As a manager of people, this job must ensure all employees within the business unit comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls



  





**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:** 




**JOB DIMENSIONS:** 




**Experience:** 
 7\+ years of experience
 


* As a manager of people, this job has the authority to assign tasks to employees within their span of control, select individuals for hire, assess individual performance, make employee compensation decisions, and take disciplinary measures up to and including termination
* Leads a critical reconciliation function supporting multiple business lines, with accountability for service delivery, regulatory reporting, suspense account oversight, and control effectiveness
* Manages team capacity, operational performance, and stakeholder engagement across Operations, Finance, Technology, Risk, Compliance, and Audit in a regulated environment.



  





**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):** 




**KNOWLEDGE AND SKILL REQUIREMENTS:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations Management, or a related field
* 7\+ years of relevant experience in Capital Markets operations, reconciliations, or settlements, with at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role
* Demonstrated experience leading reconciliation operations in a regulated environment
* Proven experience leading operational change, business transformation, or process migration initiatives
* Deep knowledge of reconciliation processes, including automated and manual reconciliations, exception management, suspense account oversight, and operational control frameworks
* Strong understanding of Capital Markets operations and related financial products; experience with Securities Lending, Equity Trading, OTC Derivatives, and Collateral Management is an asset
* Hands\-on knowledge of reconciliation platforms such as TLM and familiarity with systems including DTC, CDS, Broadridge (ADP), Fund SERV, GOW, and similar operational tools
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess data, identify trends, determine root causes, and drive effective decisions
* Ability to translate business needs into operational and technology requirements to support strategic and process improvements
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, planning, prioritization, and decision\-making skills
* Strong risk awareness and commitment to compliance, governance, and control discipline



  





**Privacy:** 




 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Customer Experience Team Manager (Pune)
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get to Know our Team:**
 Agoda’s Customer Support Team understands that travel can be an everchanging environment. That is why we provide in\-person, real\-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each and every customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer’s experience. We quickly adapt to challenges by collaborating with other teams and experimenting on everything we can. This has allowed us to develop new and effective products that produce meaningful results and continue to drive Agoda’s business performance. Our Customer Support Team serves a daily role in contributing to a core strength and service of Agoda with a clear vision and a focus on efficient and satisfying customer support.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 Are you passionate about travel and about people? Do you enjoy interacting with people as well as utilizing technology?
   

  

 We are looking for a talented, energetic, results\-oriented person who loves working in a fast\-paced,multinational environment. As a Contact Center Team Manager based in Pune
 **,** 
 you will support both determined business objectives (KPIs) as well as acting as a motivator and decision maker to ensure that the group is working efficiently and in unity.
   

  

 In this position, you will work closely with the operations management team and other departments within Agoda Customer Experience Group (CEG) to support our contact center. The team manager of operations will provide directions, instructions and guidance to the customer care specialists to achieve a certain goal. Understand the team members’ strengths, weaknesses and motivations.
   

  

 The position requires you to provide extensive coaching to our contact center agents as well as provide valuable input on processes to our operations team.
   

  

 You will also be expected to contribute with ideas for continuous organizational and employee skills development but also at the global level impacting our international contact center network.
   

  

**In this Role, you'll get to:**
* Continuously monitor the traffic \& highlight discrepancies and take actions on spot if needed to ensure that service levels are met
* Provide constructive feedback \- Coach, mentor, motivate and evaluate the performance of the team on a regular basis.
* Identify performance gaps, formulate action plans to address identified gaps, implement and monitor action plans to ensure success.
* Ensure the proper and effective implementation of new and existing customer service structures \& procedures
* Understand \& analyze traffic reports, proactively make suggestions for improvement
* Monitor team attendance, document infractions and implement corrective action
* Assist with planning/organizing the proper coverage \& align staffing
* Supervise the quality assurance process and related training of staff members to ensure quality customer service.
* Participate in recruitment activities (screening, interviewing)
* Act as a backup of Operations Manager if needed


**What you'll Need to Succeed:**
* At least 2 years of people management experience in a contact center environment.
* Must have experience managing a team of at least 15 in an inbound contact center environment.
* Excellent English communication skills (verbal \& written).
* Must have a strong track record of evaluating, analyzing, implementing, leading, and monitoring effective and efficient processes to proactively improve center efficiency and staff performance.
* Excellent personal and interpersonal skills to interact with a variety of individuals, including building strong partnerships with other departments
* Must be able to handle multiple projects and effectively manage different timelines
* Proven experience and knowledge in effective hiring, training, coaching and people management practices
* Experience in managing remote teams is an advantage
* Proficiency in Microsoft products including Word, Excel and PowerPoint

 Travel required as per business need, if any

 Permanent and Full time
   

  

**About The Job**
**Our Team:**
 Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) is an internal Sanofi resource organization based in India and is setup to centralize processes and activities to support Specialty Care, Vaccines, General Medicines, CHC, CMO, and R\&D, Data \& Digital functions . Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) strives to be a strategic and functional partner for tactical deliveries to Medical, HEVA, and Commercial organizations in Sanofi, globally.
   

  

 The Sanofi Business Operations (SBO) is built to reduce reliance on external services providers and facilitate the development of internal expertise. The Sanofi Business Operations will leverage untapped combination of talent pool.
   

  

* Main Responsibilities
* Lead and manage the Global MAP Coordinators (GMCs) team to deliver end\-to\-end MAP operations from product receipt through to product shipment for both structured programs and single patient requests across General Medicine and Specialty Care GBUs.
* Oversee MAP Operational Excellence
* Monitor and ensure timely request receipt, coordination, approval and product shipment commitments in accordance with program agreements and regulatory requirements.
* Establish and maintain robust processes for operations governance.
* Ensure full traceability and chain of custody through appropriate recording in Sanofi systems and tools.
* Drive adherence to GDP/GMP requirements and quality standards throughout MAP operations.
* Oversee MAP blueprint development and program initiation processes, ensuring Medical Product Leaders initiate discussions with identified MAP transversal teams to obtain detailed operational information confirming design, operational considerations, and execution plans per country in scope.
* Ensure compliance with material segregation and traceability requirements to maintain product integrity throughout the distribution chain.
* Manage MAP Information Package preparation and annual review processes to verify current versions of all materials, ensuring the Medical Operations Lead validates the MAP Information Package prior to program initiation and physician training
* Manage Stakeholder Coordination and RelationshipsundefinedCollaborate effectively with GBU Medical Operation teams, Global Regulatory Manager, Global Pharmacovigilance (PV) and Drug Safety teams, Quality and Risk Managers, Supply Leaders, Clinical Supply Chain Operations, Global Finance, Global Legal and MRP\-TC teams.Establish strong partnerships with Healthcare Professionals and patient advocacy groups as end beneficiaries of MAP programs.Facilitate cross\-functional alignment and resolve operational challenges.Coordinate with Country Regulatory Managers for application submissions to local Regulatory Authorities and management of approvals, including notifications of registration status and program closure requirements.Collaborate with Country Safety Heads (CSH) to ensure Global PV database configuration, safety reporting compliance, and local safety training requirements are met.Work with Local/Regional Supply Chain Managers to determine supply feasibility and coordinate commercial product supply when applicable, including patient transfer to commercial pathway upon Marketing Authorization and Reimbursement.
* Drive Operational Performance and Continuous ImprovementundefinedMonitor MAP operational KPIs and metrics to proactively identify and resolve potential challenges.Conduct periodic business reviews with relevant stakeholders to assess program performance.Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization, technology enhancement, and productivity improvements.Lead continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with Medical Operations and GBU teams.Implement and monitor performance metrics for request processing timelines, including acknowledgement of Program Terms and Conditions, data privacy notices, physician eligibility confirmation, and patient eligibility confirmation.Establish oversight mechanisms for third\-party activities and ensure quality agreements are in place with contract givers and service providers to specify quality requirements and define respective responsibilities and commitments.
* Provide Team Leadership and DevelopmentundefinedMentor GMC team members in establishing robust MAP operational processes and expertise.Ensure effective resource allocation and workload management across the team.Drive knowledge sharing, best practices implementation, and capability building within the team.Manage team performance and remove impediments affecting operational delivery.Provide training and development on MAP request assessment processes, including eligibility determination, completeness review, and workflow confirmation based on product lifecycle stage, existence of pre\-established Medical Eligibility Criteria, and alliances with other partners.
* Ensure Compliance and Risk ManagementundefinedIdentify, escalate, and manage deviations and risks associated with MAP Request management.Ensure adherence to international regulatory requirements and Sanofi policies.Support audit preparations and respond to regulatory inspections as required.Ensure compliance with documentation retention requirements, maintaining confidential MAP program documentation for a period of ten (10\) years after program closure in the country, unless applicable laws and regulations require otherwise, and ensure prior notification to Sanofi before destroying any essential documents related to a MAP request.Implement and oversee pharmacovigilance requirements including Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) management, safety signal monitoring, periodic safety reporting, and maintenance of Reference Safety Information in alignment with regulatory pharmacovigilance obligations.Ensure all MAP activities comply with ICH Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System requirements and current Good Distribution Practice (GDP) and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) guidelines.Manage Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) processes to correct deviations and prevent recurrence across MAP operations.Oversee supplier qualification processes, maintain quality management systems for all MAP\-related activities, and ensure subcontractor management procedures are in place for all third\-party service providers.
* People: (1\) Primary point of contact for local medical teams globally for MAP questions, case submissions, process inquiries etc.;(2\) Responds to internal and external inquiries regarding Sanofi or Affiliate MAP (3\) Liaise and coordinate with colleagues from Global \& Local medical teams, Project Management team, and Quality; (4\) Provide reporting and MAP program updates (as needed) to global medical teams (5\) Maintain Global contacts lists for MAP communications·
* Performance: (1\) Ensure deliverables meet the required timelines, quality targets and adhere to the compliance requirements;(2\) Managing MAP requests related documents timely storage and retrieval; (3\) Escalating MAP requests to MRPTC process and managing the documentation (4\) Timely sharing the MRPTC meeting notes to all the relevant stakeholders with appropriate actions; (5\) Adhering to affiliate process while processing affiliate requests·
* Process: (1\) Receive and track all MAP requests for assigned portfolio ensuring evaluation and response to requesting physician are completed in a timely manner; (2\) Upload and organize all relevant documentation within SharePoint site and ensure audit\-ready environment; (3\) Identify best practices and operational efficiencies within assigned MAP portfolio; (4\) Participate in cross\-functional Global MAP meetings to understand and anticipate pipeline products that would be eligible for MAP; (5\) Assist medical teams to liaise with Global and/or MRP\-TC secretary for all requests that require escalation; (6\) Owner of MAP documentation including criteria, application forms, decision letters and training manuals; Partnering with Medical, Legal and Compliance teams to ensure documentation meets patient privacy requirements and disease specific guidelines; (7\) Prepare and provide documentation to support audit\-related activities to ensure compliance with Sanofi policies \& procedures at the local, regional and global level.
* Stakeholders: (1\) MAP Operations \& Efficiency lead; (2\) MAP Governance Leads; (3\) Local medical teams; (4\) Quality; (5\) MRPTC team; (6\) Affiliates (7\) CMO office About youExperience:
* 12\+ years' experience managing projects and stakeholders in life sciences or pharmaceutical organization.
* Direct experience in operations management, Project Management and people management.
* Experience working across different therapeutic areas is an advantage.

title: IT&D Manager, Service Delivery
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Information Technology \& Digital
   

  

 In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products.
   

  

 Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen.
   

  

 Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The IT\&D Manager, IT Service Delivery is accountable for the end\-to\-end service delivery, operational performance, and continual improvement of IT applications and services aligned to a defined Business Capability Stream (e.g. HR, Finance, ERP, Supply, Marketing, R\&D) within a predominantly outsourced operating model.
   

  

 This role acts as the single point of accountability for service outcomes, ensuring that strategic service providers deliver stable, resilient, secure, and business\-aligned services that meet agreed SLAs, XLAs, and contractual commitments. The role serves as the primary business\-facing IT partner, translating business priorities into operational requirements and orchestrating internal IT teams and multiple suppliers to deliver seamless, high\-quality services.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* End\-to\-End Service Accountability
* Own the end\-to\-end operational performance of all applications and services within the assigned capability stream, regardless of supplier or delivery tower.
* Act as the business\-facing service owner, accountable for availability, reliability, performance, and user experience.
* Ensure services are operated as integrated end\-to\-end value streams, not disconnected vendor silos.
* Supplier \& SIAM\-Oriented Service Orchestration
* Lead and govern strategic managed service providers, SaaS vendors, and system integrators delivering application and service support.
* Operate as part of a SIAM\-style model, ensuring clear RACI, handoffs, and collaboration across multiple suppliers.
* Hold suppliers accountable for outcomes, not effort, including SLA performance, incident quality, proactive problem prevention, and continuous improvement.
* Service Performance \& Governance
* Define, manage, and continuously improve SLAs, XLAs and KPIs aligned to business priorities and critical business events.
* Ensure transparent, accurate, and meaningful reporting focused on:
* Business impact
* Service stability
* User experience
* Root cause and trend insights
* Stakeholder \& Business Relationship Management
* Serve as the primary IT service delivery partner for senior stakeholders within the aligned capability stream.
* Translate business demand, priorities, and pain points into service delivery objectives and supplier commitments.
* Proactively communicate service health, risks, and improvement actions using clear, business\-focused language.
* Represent operational readiness, risk, and service impact in business governance forums.
* Incident, Major Incident \& Problem Management
* Ensure robust incident and major incident management across suppliers, including escalation, coordination, and communications.
* Drive Problem Management discipline across vendors, ensuring root causes are identified, recurring issues eliminated, and permanent fixes delivered.
* Hold suppliers accountable for preventable incidents and repeat failures.
* Change, Release \& Service Transition Oversight
* Govern supplier\-led change and release activities to balance speed, stability, and risk.
* Accountable for service transition readiness for new systems, enhancements, or supplier changes, including:
* Support models
* Knowledge transfer
* Runbooks
* Monitoring and alerting
* Service desk enablement
* Operational Risk, Resilience \& Compliance
* Identify and manage service delivery risks across suppliers, including capacity, resilience, security, and compliance.
* Ensure services adhere to internal controls, audit requirements, and regulatory obligations.
* Continual Improvement, Automation \& Efficiency
* Use incident, problem, and performance data to prioritise improvement initiatives.
* Drive automation, simplification, and standardisation across suppliers to:
* Reduce manual effort
* Improve stability
* Lower run costs
* Enhance user experience
* Financial \& Contractual Management (Run Services)
* Manage run\-state costs associated with the service portfolio, including vendor spend and support contracts.
* Ensure cost transparency and value\-for\-money from service providers.
* Support commercial governance, contract compliance, and service demand prioritisation.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Proven experience leading IT service delivery in an outsourced or SIAM\-based environment.
* Strong expertise in ITIL\-based service management (incident, problem, change, service transition, service level management).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple suppliers and drive end\-to\-end service outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with senior business leaders.
* Experience supporting large\-scale enterprise platforms (e.g. SAP, Siebel, SuccessFactors, Oracle, Salesforce, PLM).
* Financial and vendor commercial management experience.
* Exposure to automation, observability, and modern operations practices (AIOps concepts).
* Deep hands\-on experience with ServiceNow as the enterprise IT Service Management platform, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Service Level Management.
* Understanding of ServiceNow CMDB, service mapping, and dependency modelling to enable true end\-to\-end service ownership.
* Experience defining and governing ITSM workflows, SLAs/XLAs, dashboards, and reporting within ServiceNow, and using ServiceNow data and insights to drive operational performance, problem reduction, and continual service improvement.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* Stable, predictable services with minimal business disruption
* Suppliers operating as one integrated service ecosystem
* Reduced incident volumes and repeat issues
* Clear service ownership and accountability
* Improved business satisfaction and trust in IT delivery


 The skills for success
   

  

 Service Delivery, IT Operations, SIAM, ITIL
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

 The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and operational excellence of production systems while leading and mentoring a team of production support engineers.
   

  

 The candidate should be comfortable navigating multiple technologies and working closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, QA, and business stakeholders to resolve critical production issues and continuously improve platform reliability.
   

  

 Your future duties and responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the triage, investigation, and resolution of complex L2/L3 production incidents in a microservices environment while ensuring adherence to SLA/SLO requirements.

* Drive continuous improvement of production support processes, monitoring capabilities, incident response, automation, and system reliability.

* Strong knowledge of Incident Management, Problem Management, Major Incident Management, and Change Management.
* Proven experience handling P1/P2 incidents and driving complex production issues to resolution.

* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
* Experience with production deployments, rollback strategies, blue/green deployments, and canary releases.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Node.js, Shell, or similar technologies.
* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder\-management, and team\-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure during critical production incidents.
* Strong ability to navigate and troubleshoot across multiple technologies rather than being limited to a single technology stack.


 Good to Have Skills
   

  

* Experience with Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/Elastic Stack, Splunk, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, or similar observability platforms.

* Experience with Kafka or other messaging technologies.

description:
**Job Title:**

**Job Purpose**

**Leadership \& Planning**

* Measure functional performance against goals, client expectations and work with EH\&S Leader to develop improvement plans.


**Work Process / Improvement**

* Analyze and evaluate site EH\&S performance to identify and implement opportunities for improvement
* Supports site compliance with Corporate EH\&S Standards and Governmental Regulatory Requirements. Provide local input to Regional EH\&S Leader for regulatory strategies and advocacy.

* Supports regional corporate Process Safety and Containment work process implementation.
* Ensures all appropriate IH programs, monitoring and health surveillance requirements are met.
* Facilitates incident investigations and root cause analyses.
* Support contractor companies with site EHS standards compliance.
* Assist site responses to geographic and/or site EH\&S / Emergency Response \& Security (ER\&S) issues (in concert with ER\&S Team) and crises that affect operations consistent with site, business, and corporate "license to operate" requirements.

* Ensure delivery of required EH\&S training.
* Lead, support, participate in and/or provide data for EH\&S audits / assessments / compliance initiatives.
* Collects, analyzes, calculates and inputs data for EH\&S reporting as necessary.
* Performs field observations and safety interventions.
* Completes documentation and facilitates waste characterizations.
* Monitors EH\&S compliance tasks completion.
* Initiates and/or supports Site Management of Change (MoC) for EH\&S matters as necessary.
* Links to EH\&S CoE to obtain clear interpretations on site\-specific regulatory processes, regulations, laws and associated procedures.
* As required, participates in the environmental, IH, health and safety related reviews and project support.
* Aligns with Information Technology (IT) initiatives, updates, cyber security processes and tools.


**Networks**
* Participate in global cross\-functional networks and leadership teams.
* Participate and support regional EH\&S network in order to drive improvement and facilitate change.
* Support community initiatives and/or communication networks in order to sustain the companies' public 'License to Operate'.
* Support EH\&S advocacy initiatives including proactive value\-based participation in relevant regional area industry, professional associations and external networks per the direction of the Regional EH\&S Leader.


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s/Masters degree in an applicable scientific discipline is required; Professional certification where applicable
* 10\+ years of relevant industry experience, knowledge and skills in a manufacturing / industrial environment
* Fluent in English
* Willing to travel 30\-50%


**Knowledge \& Skills**
* Demonstrated knowledge of all EH\&S work processes, in addition to regional site operations and processes
* Demonstrated knowledge of all regulatory, permit, and company requirements for the region, including audit requirements
* Working knowledge of ER\&S work processes
* Facilitates development and leveraging of expertise

* Ability to manage multiple projects and set priorities
* Works methodically and meets required deadlines. Well organized with a demonstrated ability to work without supervision
* Excellent consultation, facilitation, and influencing skills
* Excellent inter\-personal relationship skills to all levels in an organization
* Demonstrated open and clear communications and processes for issue resolution
* Demonstrated leadership and mentoring skills
* Excellent English / local language verbal and written communication skills. Excellent training and presentation skills
* Ability to analyze technical writing and regulations

title: Lead - Facilities & Admin
description:
We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Facility \& Administration Executive to oversee the day\-to\-day administration and facility operations across our office premises. The ideal candidate will ensure a safe, efficient, and well\-maintained workplace while coordinating with internal stakeholders and external vendors to deliver seamless administrative support.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



**Facility Management** 



* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of office facilities, ensuring a clean, safe, and productive work environment.
* Oversee housekeeping, security, cafeteria, pantry, and office maintenance services.
* Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of office infrastructure, electrical systems, HVAC, plumbing, and office equipment.
* Ensure all facility\-related issues are resolved within agreed service levels.
* Conduct periodic facility inspections and recommend improvements.



**Administration** 



* Manage office administration, including seating arrangements, visitor management, access control, parking, and office supplies.
* Handle procurement of office stationery, pantry supplies, and administrative consumables.
* Maintain office assets, inventory records, and vendor documentation.
* Coordinate employee onboarding and offboarding from a facilities perspective (workspace allocation, ID cards, access cards, etc.).
* Support office events, employee engagement activities, and leadership meetings



**Vendor Management** 



* Identify, onboard, and manage facility and administration vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to service\-level agreements (SLAs).
* Process vendor invoices, purchase orders, and payment requests in coordination with the Finance team.
* Negotiate vendor contracts and optimize operational costs.



**Compliance \& Safety** 



* Ensure compliance with workplace safety standards and statutory regulations.
* Coordinate fire safety drills, emergency preparedness activities, and health \& safety audits.
* Maintain records related to facility compliance, insurance, licenses, and certifications.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure a safe and compliant workplace.



**Budget \& Reporting** 



* Assist in preparing and managing the annual administration and facility budget.
* Track facility expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports related to administration, facilities, vendor performance, and expenses.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hospitality, Facility Management, or a related discipline.
* 4–10 years of experience in Facility Management and Administration.
* Experience managing corporate offices, preferably in a technology, startup, or corporate environment.
* Strong vendor and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Good knowledge of office administration processes.
* Familiarity with facility management systems and workplace operations.
* Experience in procurement and inventory management.
* Working knowledge of workplace safety and statutory compliance.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

title: Matte Painting Supervisor
description:
Eyeline is a global team of risk takers, innovators and perfectionists who achieve creative visions and have fun doing it. A dynamic workforce nestled within the industry’s most intriguing cities, united by a drive to push the boundaries of storytelling. Learn more.
   

  

 We are seeking a talented and experienced Matte Painting Supervisor to join our dynamic Visual Effects team. The ideal candidate will have a strong artistic vision and technical expertise to lead the matte painting department in creating stunning and photorealistic environments. You will work closely with the VFX Supervisor, Art Director, and other department leads to ensure the seamless integration of both 2D and 3D matte paintings into the overall visual effects pipeline.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and mentor the matte painting team, fostering artistic growth and technical development in both 2D and 2\.5D environments
* Supervise the creation of high\-quality matte paintings and digital environments for feature films, television, and other media
* Collaborate with the VFX Supervisor and Art Director to establish the visual style and quality standards for matte paintings, ensuring consistency across 2D and 3D work
* Ensure the seamless integration of matte paintings with live\-action footage and CG elements
* Develop and maintain efficient workflows and best practices for the matte painting department, incorporating both 2D and 3D techniques
* Provide creative and technical solutions to challenges in the production pipeline
* Review and provide constructive feedback on matte paintings to ensure artistic and technical excellence
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to keep the department at the forefront of innovation


**Qualifications**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in visual effects, with a strong background in matte painting, including both 2D and 2\.5D work
* Proven leadership experience managing teams or departments in a fast\-paced production environment
* Expert\-level proficiency in industry\-standard software (e.g., Adobe Photoshop, Nuke, Maya) for both 2D and 2\.5D matte painting
* Strong understanding of perspective, lighting, and color theory
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to manage complex projects and team needs simultaneously
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills with a collaborative and team\-oriented mindset
* Experience developing and maintaining workflows in coordination with pipeline and technical teams
* Experience in high\-end feature film or episodic TV productions (preferred)
* Background in DMP supervision or departmental leadership (preferred)
* Familiarity with 3D modeling and rendering software (e.g., Houdini, 3ds Max)
* Knowledge of scripting (Python, MEL) for pipeline tools and automation a plus
* Experience in generative workflows a plus


**About Us**
 Eyeline is a global creative studio partnering with storytellers to turn their ambitions into stunning reality. By blending the time\-honored craft of filmmaking with breakthrough technologies, we unlock bold, cinematic visions at scale. Our three pillars \- VFX, Studios and Labs \- form the creative spine of Eyeline, guiding how we think, work, and show up in every frame.
   

  

 At Eyeline, we believe technology serves artistry and our people are the soul behind everything we do, deepening creative connection, rather than replacing it. In addition to our work with Netflix, we continue to partner with a wide range of long\-standing and new clients worldwide.
   

  

 Come as you are
   

  

 We are looking for those seeking to take risks with us, those driven by passion for their craft. To us, these are key ingredients that we look for in our team. We are committed to ensuring fair and equal treatment of your application. When you apply for a role with us, you will receive consideration based solely on your qualifications.

title: Manager, Platform Engineering — Application Platform
description:
**Overview**
**Manager, Platform Engineering — Application Platform**
 📍
 **Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India 🏢
 **Work Arrangement:** 
 Hybrid – 2 days per week in the office
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for an
 **Engineering Manager** 
 to lead our Application Platform team in Hyderabad — a newly formed team and a deliberate expansion of what our platform organization offers.
   

  

 Hyland runs an internal Kubernetes platform that product teams deploy onto, across AWS and Azure. Two teams own it. One keeps the platform running.
 **This team builds the interfaces product teams actually use** 
 — self\-service provisioning of cloud resources, GitOps\-based delivery and promotion, environment and tenancy management, and cloud\-agnostic abstractions that behave the same way on either cloud. When a product team needs a queue, a bucket, an environment, or a path to production, they get it from this team's work — not from a ticket.
   

  

 Some capabilities are already in motion, some already have users — but much of what this team will own is still to be defined and built.
 **You'd be shaping it early** 
 , with real room to influence the direction rather than inherit it.
   

  

 Success looks like product teams choosing the paved road over building their own, new services reaching production faster, developers who'd recommend the platform to a peer, and reliable operation of the services your team owns. If you think of other engineers as your customers and thrive at the intersection of technical leadership and platform strategy — we'd love to connect.
   

  

**Your Role Responsibilities? Here's What You'll Do.**
* Lead, coach, and grow a distributed team of platform engineers across multiple time zones — owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development to build a high\-performing, accountable team.
* Own the direction of a self\-service provisioning capability that lets product teams declare the cloud resources they need through a Kubernetes\-native API, with security, tagging, and cost guardrails applied by default.
* Own the delivery and promotion capabilities product teams use to reach production — including GitOps\-based deployment, environment progression, approval and traceability controls, and progressive delivery patterns for teams running clusters outside the central platform.
* Drive a set of workload abstractions that behave consistently across AWS and Azure, so a team productive on one cloud is equally productive on the other without reinventing their workflow.
* Treat adoption as a first\-class outcome — define what good looks like, instrument it, reduce the time it takes a team to get from nothing to running in production, and retire work that isn't earning its keep.
* Run what you build — your team carries on\-call for the services it owns and is accountable for reliability, security posture, and compliance obligations; partner with runtime infrastructure, developer experience, and product engineering to maintain a single coherent path onto the platform.


**Technology Tools**
* Kubernetes \& Container Orchestration
* Cloud Platforms: AWS \& Azure
* Kubernetes\-Native Resource Provisioning \& Custom Resource APIs
* GitOps \& Continuous Delivery Tooling
* Infrastructure as Code \& Policy as Code
* Cloud\-Agnostic Workload Abstractions (Serverless Runtimes, Event\-Driven Autoscaling, Service Invocation)
* Cloud Cost Visibility \& Attribution
* Secrets Management \& Workload Identity
* Monitoring, Logging \& Observability


**Role Essentials**
* 5\+ years leading engineering teams — including teams delivering platform, infrastructure, or developer\-facing products — with a Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent experience; production Kubernetes depth with enough hands\-on fluency to review your team's work credibly and make sound architectural decisions.
* Demonstrated experience building self\-service capabilities or internal APIs that other engineering teams consumed — with evidence of the measurable adoption that followed; product instincts applied internally, prioritizing against outcomes rather than requests and saying no to work that won't move adoption.
* Strong hands\-on fluency with infrastructure as code and cloud\-native services on both AWS and Azure; experience operating under security and compliance obligations such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001\.
* Experience leading a distributed engineering team across multiple time zones — including asynchronous collaboration, shared on\-call responsibilities, and accountability for managing to a budget.
* Comfortable negotiating priorities, standards, and interfaces with peer managers; excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with working knowledge of Agile or Scrum delivery practices.


**What We'd Like to See**
* Built self\-service capabilities that measurably reduced how often product teams needed to ask the platform team for anything — freeing both sides to move faster.
* Designed an API or abstraction that outlived the first use case it was built for — and successfully migrated consumers off a deprecated interface without stalling their roadmaps.
* Made a platform behave consistently across two clouds and turned developer experience from an opinion into something measured, tracked, and continuously improved.
* Grown engineers into senior or lead roles through intentional coaching, structured feedback, and deliberate career development investment.
* Background in enterprise software or another environment with real security scrutiny — where reliability, compliance, and customer trust are non\-negotiable and built into how you operate.

title: GVP, Global Product Development - (Evergreen)
description:
**About Rimini Street, Inc.**
 Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a proven, trusted global provider of end\-to\-end, mission\-critical enterprise software support, managed services and innovative Agentic AI ERP solutions, and is the leading third\-party support provider for Oracle, SAP and VMware software.
   

  

 Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.
   

  

 The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission\-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.
   

  

 We are actively seeking a
 **GVP, Global Product Development.** 
 The role will be based in Hyderabad . The role will report directly to the EVP \& Chief Delivery Officer of Rimini Street.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The
 **GVP, Global Product Development** 
 is responsible for the overall strategy, governance, performance, and business outcomes of Rimini Street's Product Development organization. The role provides executive leadership across the commercialization, operationalization, delivery, maintenance, and lifecycle management of Tax, Legal \& Regulatory solutions, product enhancements, new product introductions, and hot fix delivery. The role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, client commitments, and technology investments while driving scalable, predictable, and supportable delivery outcomes.
   

  

 Serving as the bridge between product strategy and engineering execution, this leader is accountable for bringing products and services to market, establishing operational readiness, and ensuring they are successfully adopted, scaled, supported, and sustained throughout their lifecycle.
   

  

 This leader will be responsible for building a scalable global product development model that supports Rimini Street's enterprise software services portfolio, improves speed and quality of delivery, strengthens product and regulatory execution, and drives operational excellence through modern development practices, automation, Agile/DevOps discipline, and cross\-functional collaboration
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Lead the global Product Development organization and establish the vision, strategy, operating model, and priorities that support the Company's growth objectives.
* Own the development execution, productization, lifecycle management, and operational performance of the Product Development portfolio, including Tax, Legal \& Regulatory product delivery, Product Maintenance \& Enhancements, New Product Introduction, and Hot Fix Management.
* Serve as the executive owner responsible for transitioning new products, services, tools, and capabilities from Research \& Development into production operations, ensuring successful commercialization, scalability, supportability, and long\-term lifecycle management.
* Establish governance, prioritization frameworks, and investment strategies to ensure development resources are aligned to the highest business and client value opportunities.
* Partner with executive leadership, Product, Research \& Development, Support, Managed Services, Professional Services, Sales, and Client Onboarding to align development priorities with company objectives, market opportunities, and client requirements.
* Oversee portfolio planning, resource strategy, organizational design, workforce planning, and budget management for the global Product Development organization.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators, operational metrics, and governance processes to improve product quality, delivery effectiveness, scalability, customer adoption, and business performance.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, modern engineering practices, process optimization, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Serve as the executive point of accountability for development\-related business risks, strategic initiatives, product readiness, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Build, develop, and mentor a high\-performing leadership team while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, quality, and operational excellence.
* Represent Product Development in executive, client, partner, and strategic stakeholder engagements as required.
* Drive long\-term organizational capability, succession planning, and talent development to support future business growth.
* Partner with Product Management, Global Tax, and Research \& Development leadership to transition approved product strategies and requirements into scalable, supportable, and commercially viable products and services.
* Accountable for operational readiness, adoption, supportability, and long\-term success of products and services following General Availability.


**Desired Experience**
* 15\+ years of leadership experience in enterprise software development, product management, technology services, or related organizations.
* Proven success leading global, multi\-functional teams with responsibility for strategy, business outcomes, financial performance, and organizational growth.
* Experience bringing enterprise software products and services from concept through commercialization, General Availability, and ongoing lifecycle management.
* Experience managing product development portfolios that include regulatory, compliance, enhancement, and new product initiatives.
* Demonstrated success driving innovation, automation, organizational transformation, and operational excellence in a global environment.


**Desired Skills**
* Executive leadership skills with the ability to establish vision, strategy, and organizational direction across a global product development organization.
* Strong business and financial acumen with experience balancing client commitments, product investments, operational performance, and company growth objectives.
* Exceptional strategic planning, prioritization, and decision\-making capabilities in complex, matrixed environments.
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high\-performing global leadership teams while driving accountability and operational excellence.
* Excellent communication, influence, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to align executive leaders, clients, and cross\-functional organizations around common goals.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software product lifecycle management, commercialization, operational readiness, and scalable delivery models from General Availability through ongoing enhancement and support.


**Education**
 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) required; advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

**Location**
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Why Rimini Street?**
 We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top\-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.
   

  

 Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:
   

  

* Company
+ We dream big and innovate boldly.


* Colleagues
+ We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.


* Clients

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services
   

  

**Process Overview** 
**\***
 The Stock Loan Associate in BACI will support the stock loan operational area in the following capacities
   

  

* Process Intercompany transactions including, but not limited to; share and cash settlements for the MLPFS counterparty entity and MLI counterparty entity, collateral movement, margining of positions, fail research and resolution.
* Research, Compile, and Reconcile stock loan breaks resulting from depot/blotter differences, cash offset breaks, DTC/Loanet breaks and breaks resulting from various blotter/AP breaks
* Support the Repo process through the booking of borrows and loans in various systems and ensuring share movements through various streams
* Maintain and record all activities in accordance to pre\-established SEC record and retention format
* Support regulatory and audit requests to both internal business partners and


 External regulators expeditiously.
   

  

**Job Description** 
**\***
 Agreement and processing of settled items with MLPFS and MLI counterparties and the subsequent collateral movement for such.
   

  

 Daily reconciliation of said movements to ensure 100% balancing of activity and cash
   

  

 Process mark to market transactions either via manual or automated platforms
   

  

 The ability to isolate cash, stock and other breaks daily and process necessary Stock Record adjustments to correct breaks due to various reasons
   

  

 Navigate through vendor based and internal stock loan processing systems to process daily activity
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
**\***

**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 At Peloton, we don't just implement technology. We transform the way organizations work, compete, and grow. Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing companies in the US, Peloton is one of the most respected and fastest\-growing global Oracle consulting firms, delivering Advisory, Consulting, and Managed Services to leading organizations across many industries, including Retail, Financial Services, Manufacturing, Consumer Packaged Goods, and more.
   

  

 Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know\-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

 Peloton is looking to expand our Close and Consolidation capabilities. We are looking for candidates, across all levels that are interested in the opportunity to play a role in the growth and development of Peloton’s Financial Reporting \& Consolidations Practice. We are specifically looking for team members with demonstrated experience with Oracle \| Hyperion Financial Management, Cloud Solutions, and supporting technologies. Our consultants will be responsible for delivering implementations of Oracle Account Reconciliation Cloud Service (ARCS) and Financial Consolidation \& Close Cloud Service (FCCS) for Peloton clients. As a team member on your projects, you will be gathering requirements from client team members, including C\-level executives, and delivering solutions.
   

  

 The right candidates will possess an eagerness to partner with business leaders to develop unique and innovative solutions that result in real business results. Chosen candidates will have the opportunity to be involved in a variety of team\-based projects throughout the project lifecycle such as requirements Peloton \|Job Description Page 1 PCG Job Description gathering, process re\-engineering, solution design, implementation, and delivery. Peloton also places a high value on internal contributions through the support and development of the firm and its team members.
   

  

 This role requires working IST hours (5:30 PM to 2:30 AM) and a minimum of 15\+ years of relevant experience. Candidates based in Hyderabad or Bangalore are preferred, as these are our primary hiring locations.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced and client\-focused Manager to lead Oracle Supply Chain Management (SCM) support operations for global clients. The ideal candidate should possess strong Oracle SCM functional expertise, leadership capabilities, excellent client\-facing skills, and hands\-on experience in managing support delivery in a global onsite/offshore model.
   

  

 This role requires close collaboration with clients, internal functional and technical teams, and Oracle Support to ensure high\-quality service delivery, SLA adherence, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement. The candidate is expected to work both as a manager and an individual contributor by actively supporting critical SCM tickets while guiding the team.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 14\+ years of experience working with Oracle SCM modules.

**Required Experience \& Skills**

* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience in Oracle SCM Cloud (Fusion) implementation or support engagements.
* Strong functional expertise in at least three of the following modules:
* Costing
* Manufacturing
* Planning
* Order Management
* Strong understanding of Supply Chain business processes and Oracle SCM functional flows.
* Experience in Oracle SCM production support and/or end\-to\-end implementations.

**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 As the Team Lead for KYC Operations on our newly established Deactivations Team, you will be at the forefront of strengthening Wise's commitment to regulatory compliance and protecting our financial ecosystem. Your mission is to build and guide a team of senior analysts who will become the authority in enhanced due diligence (EDD) and masters of risk assessment. You will lead your team who investigate complex KYC cases, empowering them with the duty to guarantee that every decision is compliant and accurate. It's a team that delivers justice and upholds our integrity when it matters the most.
   

  

 As this is a newly formed team at Wise, you won't just be following established guidelines \- you'll be a primary architect in their creation. You will lead the effort to shape the team's processes, enhance its tools, and develop its operational strategy. Your leadership, insights, and the feedback from your team will be crucial in building this function from the ground up.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity for a sharp, inspiring leader who excels in high\-pressure situations and has a passion for developing expert investigators. If you are eager to build a team of subject matter experts in the comprehensive KYC/FinCrime arena and seek a position where your leadership will significantly influence our clients, enhance our reputation, and mentor the next wave of talent —then this opportunity is perfect for you.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high\-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
* People management Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Analysts. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviours, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check\-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions.
* Operational management Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high\-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations.
* Performance management Measure team KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are met while maintaining focus on customer experience. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit.
* Expertise Sharing Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk\-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership.
* Planning and execution Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals.
* Stakeholder management and communication Collaborate closely with your stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. You communicate mindfully and professionally while choosing the right formats and platforms to convey your message to a wider audience in a timely manner. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and it has a clear scope that includes potential impact in different areas.
* Quality assurance and control Implement and maintain a robust quality assurance framework for your team. Conduct regular checks and reviews of your team’s casework to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to the highest standards of our policies and regulatory obligations. Provide targeted coaching and constructive feedback based on quality findings to drive continuous improvement. Analyse quality metrics to identify trends, address root causes of errors, and develop initiatives that enhance the team's overall performance and mitigate risk.


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

 Blue Dart Express Limited, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

 Position Overview:
   

  

 The PUD Manager is responsible for leading the end\-to\-end operations of one or more Pickup \& Delivery Units (PUDs), ensuring safe, timely and cost\-effective execution of first\-mile pickup, last\-mile delivery and customer service operations. The role is accountable for operational performance, fleet readiness, workforce productivity, customer satisfaction and service quality across the assigned locations.
   

  

 Reporting to the Regional PUD Manager, the incumbent leads frontline operational teams, coordinates with cross\-functional stakeholders and transport partners, and ensures seamless integration of pickup, delivery and hub operations. The role drives operational discipline, revenue assurance, people capability and continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with organisational standards and customer commitments.
   

  

 Job Purpose:
   

  

 To lead and manage the operations of assigned Pickup \& Delivery Units by delivering operational excellence, customer service, workforce productivity, fleet optimisation and revenue assurance while ensuring safe, compliant and profitable first\-mile and last\-mile operations aligned with Blue Dart's service standards.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 PUD Operations Leadership
   

  

  

* Lead the overall operations of the assigned PUD(s), ensuring consistent achievement of operational, service and business objectives.
* Drive operational planning and execution across pickup, delivery and customer service activities.
* Ensure adherence to operational workflows, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and service commitments.
* Monitor daily operational performance and implement timely corrective actions to address service gaps.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, fleet and infrastructure to support business requirements.


 Pickup \& Delivery Operations
   

  

  

* Manage first\-mile pickup and last\-mile delivery operations to achieve committed service levels and customer expectations.
* Monitor daily pickup schedules, delivery performance and route execution to maximise operational efficiency.
* Ensure timely processing, dispatch and movement of shipments through seamless coordination with hubs and service centres.
* Drive reduction in missed pickups, delivery exceptions, return\-to\-origin (RTO) cases and operational delays.
* Monitor shipment visibility and ensure timely closure of operational exceptions.


 Customer Service \& Service Quality
   

  

  

* Drive customer service excellence by ensuring adherence to pickup and delivery commitments.
* Partner with Customer Service teams to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and service issues.
* Monitor customer feedback, operational performance and Net Promoter Score (NPS) trends to improve customer experience.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of operational issues impacting customers.
* Support implementation of initiatives to improve customer satisfaction, service reliability and operational quality.


 Fleet, Route \& Resource Management
   

  

  

* Ensure optimum deployment and utilisation of fleet resources to support daily pickup and delivery operations.
* Coordinate with Fleet Operations teams and transport partners to ensure vehicle availability and route optimisation.
* Monitor route productivity, vehicle utilisation and operational efficiency across assigned PUDs.
